name: Linux Face ID
description: Local face recognition: live detection/recognition state, similarity score, enrollment and verification, powered by OpenCV YuNet + SFace through a private Unix-socket backend. Reads the webcam only while the panel is watching; no network.
author: nbz
permissions: Access to the local V4L2 webcam (/dev/video0), only while watching or enrolling
Reads and writes the face profile in ~/.local/share/linux-faceid
Runs a local Python backend (python3); never sends data over the network
